package.description: Free download manager that combines Wi-Fi, Ethernet and your phone's connection to download files faster.

en-US.description: Free download manager that combines Wi-Fi, Ethernet and your phone's connection to download files faster.
en-US.longDescription:
Mascot is a free, open-source download manager that uses every internet connection your computer has at the same time. Wi-Fi, Ethernet and your phone's hotspot or USB tethering work together on the same download, so files finish faster than on any one connection alone.
It has backup networks, data limits per network, backup links, a queue and schedule, torrents and magnet links, groups, and a browser extension. Mascot sends nothing about you anywhere.
en-US.name: Mascot
